decisions.statement: Subagents run from a single kind at the same time.
A kind's prompt is the whole of the context a subagent of that kind starts with.
A kind's definition is the one thing a seat reads to choose between kinds.
The name a seat dispatches a kind by is a property rather than the kind's title.
A kind stating no model runs on the model of the seat that dispatched the subagent.
A subagent's dispatched-as reaches a kind page rather than being text.

definition: everything a subagent is, apart from the work it is given
